rationale: Material prompt requirement: A signed-in micro-posting-service search workflow that returns all requested visible metadata and supports the last-week constraint.. Comparing the complete source-visible workflow with the prompt: It offers a read-only social-service search and visible-result extraction route, but the source-visible contract does not establish the requested signed-in micro-posting workflow or the complete time-filtered packet of author details, timestamps, engagement counts, media flags, links, and canonical URLs.
